## Domain
<!-- Pick the closest match: hydraulics, network-modelling, water-quality,
     transients, leakage, calibration, optimisation, scientific-writing,
     or other-or-unsure. -->

## What problem did you encounter?
<!-- Describe the actual task, what you tried, and what went wrong or took
     too long. -->

## What did you ask the agent?
<!-- Paste the exact prompt, or the closest version you can remember. -->

## What should the agent have produced?
<!-- Describe the expected output and how you would recognise a correct
     result. -->

## Inputs and data
<!-- What files, formats, units, or network data does the task involve?
     Do not upload confidential data. -->

## Software and version
<!-- Name the software and the version you actually used, for example
     "EPANET 2.2" or "WNTR 1.x". -->

## References
<!-- Manuals, standards, papers, or internal documents that define correct
     practice. Do not invent citations. -->

## Transcript (optional)
<!-- Paste the relevant part of the session. Remove credentials and
     confidential data. You can also attach it in a follow-up comment. -->

## Confirmations
<!-- All of the following must be true: -->
- [ ] This describes a problem I actually encountered, not a hypothetical improvement.
- [ ] I have not included credentials, personal data, or confidential network data.
- [ ] I understand that a domain reviewer must approve the method before it is published.
- [ ] I am willing to answer follow-up questions about the expected result.
